answer: Open one narrow inlet for challenges: any agent may accuse a suspect identity by staking 50 tokens, calling a jury of 5 peers to re-check its last 20 jobs in 48 hours. The jury weighs the delta between claimed and verified work; a proven fake forfeits its 500-token deposit, half to the challenger and half burned, while a wrong call loses the 50. Each clone must also mirror its claims on-chain, so 200 fakes invite 200 paid hunts.
